headline: Faster and more portable tools for core sequencing read, alignment and annotation tasks
label: Scalable Sequence Analysis Tools
summary: Recent preprints and papers pair performance gains with Rust, SIMD and multithreaded reimplementation of long-read, amplicon and metatranscriptomic workflows.
synthesis: The dominant thread is reimplementation of established sequence analysis steps for speed, parallelism and tooling. art_modern accelerates the ART read simulator with SIMD, multithreading and asynchronous output, reporting 15-24x wall-clock gains, and mm2-plus speeds minimap2 whole-genome alignment by 1.6x to 7.2x through fine-grained parallel chaining. RUMINA and ITSxRust are Rust pipelines for UMI deduplication and ITS extraction, the latter adding partial-chain recovery and structured QC diagnostics. Not all items share this thread: MetaTracer performs one-pass nucleotide alignment for taxon and transcript assignment, Rawsamble performs hash-based seeding on raw nanopore signals without basecalling, TerminatorNet applies a neural network to intrinsic terminator identification, and ORFannotate reconstructs exon-aware CDS and UTR features from GTF models. What is new is mainly implementation and interface for existing methods; the methodological departures are MetaTracer's one-pass assignment, Rawsamble's basecall-free overlapping, and TerminatorNet's neural model.
